crossRefs.note: “Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, whose sins are covered.
Blessed is the man whom the Lord will by no means charge with sin.”

So now it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.
But if what I don’t desire, that I do, it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.

translations.web: There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.
